faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for Civil Surgeon Office, Garhwa Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 25 November 2026, and candidates report at 11:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Civil Surgeon Office, Garhwa Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 4 vacancies for Medical Officer (MBBS).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Civil Surgeon Office, Garhwa Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 25 November 2026 at 11:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. Where is the walk-in interview for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Civil Surgeon Office, Garhwa.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 67 years (up to 70 years on the basis of a medical fitness certificate issued by the Civil Surgeon). Relaxation: With medical fitness certificate issued by Civil Surgeon Up to 70 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Estimated monthly emoluments Rs. 36,400 (Rs. 1400 x 26 days).

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Bachelor of Medicine, Bachelor of Surgery/MBBS Degree in any recognised Institution approved by MCI/NMC.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Working hours: 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM. Selected doctors will work as per departmental instructions. Medical fitness certificate (for doctors above 67 years) is valid for one year.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No claim of any kind for future regularisation will be accepted.
